g.text: CLAYARENA ACADEMY · MASCOT SKETCH SHEET · DRAFT
Variant C — yellow Labrador, round cartoon
Clay shooting school · Sporting™ · Compak® Sporting
Speech bubbles in English only, or silent · our own character · works on the dark site
Each shape is its own layer, so it can move alone in canvas.
Behind the stand, on a lead
ears protected, eyes on the clay
Never in front of the guns
never carries a gun or a cartridge
round head, emerald collar, clay tag
Behind the stand, on a lead, eyes on the clay
Shooter calls “Pull!” → ears flick, head follows the clay. The dog never goes forward.
on a lead, next to the handler, earmuffs on
